verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents a second-generation FP8 Transformer Engine on this part that accelerates LLM inference through PyTorch and TensorFlow. A hands-on community build reports 41k tok/s across four cards, which corroborates real inference use. However, the docs never name FP4 or any dedicated serving stack, and a community user reports that SM120 lacks tmem/tcgen05 and is poorly supported in the main libraries. Missing for 10: documented FP4 support, explicit TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support for this part, and evidence that SM120 is well supported in the major inference libraries.
